definitions.ask: Should Shift+Enter stop doing anything in the relation lists once Ctrl+Enter takes over?
definitions.why: You asked for instead-of; a no-op can't unlink a CURRENT row via Obsidian's plain-Enter fallback

choices.label: Shift+Enter becomes a no-op in relation lists; it can never fall through to plain Enter
Shift+Enter keeps opening the label field as an untaught alias; only hints and docs move
